description: This file defines a Controller class for handling reward points in the checkout process of an OpenCart e-commerce system. It manages displaying the reward points option and saving the user's selected reward points, interacting with session data, configurations, and other system components.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Controller class for managing reward points during checkout, including displaying reward options and saving user selections.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the reward points selection interface if the reward feature is enabled and the customer has reward points available.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submission of reward points selected by the user, validates the input, updates session data, and returns JSON response.
